examples.name: Information (default)
examples.description: A contained information status with a title and description.
examples.jsx: <SectionMessage title="Restricted access">You're not allowed to change these restrictions.</SectionMessage>

props.title: Restricted access
props.children: You're not allowed to change these restrictions.

examples.name: Warning with actions
examples.description: Two Link actions, separated automatically by a middot.
examples.jsx: <SectionMessage appearance="warning" title="Your trial ends soon" actions={<><Link href="/upgrade">Upgrade</Link><Link href="/billing">Billing</Link></>}>Your trial ends in three days.</SectionMessage>

props.title: Your trial ends soon
props.children: Your trial ends in three days.

examples.name: Error, dismissible
examples.description: A dismissible error message with a dismiss button in the top-right.
examples.jsx: <SectionMessage appearance="error" title="Something went wrong" isDismissible onDismiss={handleDismiss}>We couldn't save your changes.</SectionMessage>

examples.name: Urgent error (assertive)
examples.description: An urgent error using role=alert instead of the default polite status.
examples.jsx: <SectionMessage appearance="error" role="alert" title="Payment failed">Update your payment method to keep your subscription active.</SectionMessage>

props.title: Payment failed
props.children: Update your payment method to keep your subscription active.

antiExamples.name: Page-level banner
antiExamples.reason: Use Banner for a full-width, page-level announcement bar.

antiExamples.name: Transient notification
antiExamples.reason: Use Toast for a transient, auto-dismissing notification.

antiExamples.name: Dismissible hard constraint
antiExamples.reason: Do not let the user dismiss a persistent restriction they need to keep seeing.
antiExamples.jsx: <SectionMessage appearance="error" isDismissible>You do not have permission to edit this space.</SectionMessage>
